added.en: Adjust the views and compare details on the cart or notice.

added.en: Match a landmark across adjacent views and confirm the connection. Once both links are retained, inspect the service-area door.

added.en: Treat the reel signal and auto-write supply separately.

added.en: The reel enters left of A and exits right of F. Each elbow must face its neighbor.

added.zh: 沿着发亮的接口检查断点。通路恢复后，隔离 AUTO-WRITE 并切为 MANUAL，再保存配置。
added.en: Trace the lit ports to find a break. After restoring the path, isolate AUTO-WRITE, switch to MANUAL and save.
Look at the frame behind you first.

added.zh: 缺口、门槛破损和光照方向都可用来认门。
added.en: Use the notch, threshold damage and lighting direction together.

added.en: Illuminate both doors with the view buttons. Compare all three features with the entrance before walking through.

added.zh: 先对齐影像外侧的边缘。
added.en: Start with the picture’s outer edges.

added.zh: 四角的淡色标记围出了影像应在的位置。
added.en: The faint corner marks define the picture’s position.

added.zh: 选中一块，用方向键或按钮微调，让门框、墙角与地缝在相邻边缘连上，再复核。
added.en: Select a piece and nudge it with the arrow keys or buttons until the frame, corner and floor seams meet, then review.

added.en: Check the source and date of each publicity copy.

added.zh: 原宣传照片可以在此重新打开，不需要早先保存广告。
added.en: The original publicity photograph can be reopened here; an early saved ad is not needed.

added.zh: 选择留有原始来源的副本，再在并排影像中标记被修改的部分。
added.en: Choose the copy with its original provenance, then mark the altered area in the paired images.
Check the references on both files.

added.en: The role sample and original booking can both be reopened.

added.en: Open both files, add them to the comparison, then cite them and submit your reference finding.
